title: Connection pool configuration drift
safe_fix: Import the pool maximum from src.config instead of declaring a second value

title: Unsafe retry of a completed reservation
symptom: duplicate payment reservations appear after a client timeout
root_cause: retry path did not reuse the Idempotency-Key ledger entry
safe_fix: Return the prior reservation for an identical idempotency key and payload
verification: repeat a reservation with the same key

title: Correlation header dropped
symptom: upstream logs cannot be joined to the incoming request
root_cause: X-Correlation-ID was not copied to upstream headers
safe_fix: Validate and propagate the header, generating one when invalid or absent

title: Expired token accepted at boundary
symptom: token with exp equal to current time passes validation
root_cause: expiry comparison used less-than instead of less-than-or-equal
safe_fix: Reject exp <= current time and retain constant-time signature comparison
